SELECT 
    rm.riskandmarginpivot as risk_margin_record_id,
    CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric) as position_value,
    CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) as position_leverage_multiplier,
    ab.walletsum as account_balance,
    ROUND(CAST((CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) * CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric) / ab.walletsum) AS numeric), 4) as leverage_ratio,
    ROUND(CAST((CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'margin_thresholds'->>'inithold' AS numeric) / ab.margsum) * 100 AS numeric), 4) as margin_utilization,
    CASE WHEN (CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) * CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric) / ab.walletsum) > 20

    THEN true ELSE false END as critically_over_leveraged
FROM riskandmargin rm
JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
JOIN accountbalances ab ON ab.usertag = u.userstamp;
